name: io.github.frlorenzon/sienge
title: Sienge ERP
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Sienge ERP (Softplan) API — Brazilian construction management. Exposes purchase requests, approvals and purchase orders as business-level tools that resolve names to internal codes.

environmentVariables.name: SIENGE_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your company's Sienge subdomain — it composes the URL of every request

environmentVariables.name: SIENGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Sienge Bearer Token. Use this or SIENGE_USERNAME + SIENGE_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: SIENGE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Sienge user for Basic Auth, when not using SIENGE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: SIENGE_SOLICITANTE
environmentVariables.description: Sienge user that signs purchase requests. Required only to create them

environmentVariables.name: SIENGE_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Modules loaded at startup, comma-separated (e.g. 'compras'). Empty loads only the core
